# Sound Cocktail

> Sound Cocktail is a free ambient sound mixer. Mix 22 white noise and ambient sounds — rain, fire, café voices, night train, piano — and save your cup for sleep, focus or unwinding. No app to install, no account needed to start mixing.

## Pages

- [Sound Cocktail](https://soundcocktail.app/en): Mix ambient sounds like a cocktail. 22 sounds, live recordings, instrument samples and live synthesis. Save mixes as recipes and share them.
- [Sound Cocktail （中文）](https://soundcocktail.app/zh): 免费环境音混音器：22 种白噪音与环境音，随意混搭、存成一杯，助眠或专注都用得上。
- [Rain sounds for sleep](https://soundcocktail.app/en/sleep): Steady rain, a little piano and wind — the most-saved mix for sleep.
- [雨声助眠](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/sleep): 稳定的雨声、一点钢琴和风，最多人保存的助眠配方。
- [Focus sounds for studying](https://soundcocktail.app/en/focus): Café voices, keyboard taps and a little guitar for deep work and studying.
- [专注白噪音](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/focus): 咖啡馆人声、键盘轻敲和一点吉他，陪你深度工作与学习。
- [Relaxing sounds to wind down](https://soundcocktail.app/en/relax): Fire, wind and a little piano — slow sounds for the last hour of the day.
- [放松白噪音](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/relax): 篝火、风和一点钢琴，给一天最后一小时的慢声音。
- [Rain sounds](https://soundcocktail.app/en/rain): Rain on a window with a stream underneath — the plainest mix, and the most-played.
- [雨声](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/rain): 窗边的雨，下面一条溪流，站里最简单、也最多人听的配方。
- [Café ambience for writing](https://soundcocktail.app/en/cafe): Low voices, keyboard taps and a little piano — a café where nobody bothers you.
- [咖啡馆背景音](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/cafe): 低声交谈、键盘轻敲和一点钢琴，那种没人打扰你的咖啡馆的声音。
- [About Sound Cocktail](https://soundcocktail.app/en/about): Made by one independent developer. How the sounds were made, what it costs, and what it is not.
- [关于 Sound Cocktail](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/about): 一个独立开发者的作品：声音是怎么来的、多少钱、它不是什么。
- [Sound recipes](https://soundcocktail.app/en/recipes): Free ambient sound recipes for sleep, focus and rain — open any one in the mixer and make it yours.
- [声音配方](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/recipes): 助眠、专注与雨声的免费声音配方——在调音台打开任意配方，调成你的。
- [Sound Cocktail Plus](https://soundcocktail.app/en/plus): One-time sound packs — Focus Pack, Sleep Pack and Rain Night Pack. No subscription.
- [Sound Cocktail 进阶](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/plus): 一次购买的声音包：专注包、助眠包与雨夜包，不订阅。
- [Sources & licences](https://soundcocktail.app/en/sources): Where every sound comes from — real recordings, instrument samples and live synthesis, with authors and licences.
- [音源与授权](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/sources): 每个声音的出处：真实录音、乐器采样与实时合成，附作者与授权说明。

## Sound packs (one-time purchase)

- Focus Pack ($1.99 / ¥6): unlocks market voices, wooden fish & drum, wind chimes.
- Sleep Pack ($2.99 / ¥9): unlocks insects, night train, harp, forest, boat cabin.
- Rain Night Pack ($3.99 / ¥12): unlocks thunder and rainy street.

- [Sound Cocktail — full details](https://soundcocktail.app/llms-full.txt): sounds list, packs, how mixing works.
